items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, I wrote for him, but I didn’t write no different.

ctx.x: Did he ever play any of your music?
Yeah, I wrote for him, but I didn’t write no different. I just wrote from my soul. I just write what I write. If they like it, they like it. If they don’t . . .
